Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football | National U23 AFCON 2027Q: ‘I’m the best coach in the world’ – Desmond Ofei Source : Lawrence Degraft Baidoo 17 November 2026 8:08pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Black Meteors head coach Desmond Ofei says he is the best at his job in the world after guiding the team to next round of the 2027 U-23 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifiers.
Ghana advanced into the next stage of the competition following a 3-2 aggregate win over Libya to set up a clash with Niger.
Ofei’s side, who had lost 1-0 in the first leg in Bengharzi, turned the tie around with a 3-1 victory at the Accra Sports Stadium on Tuesday afternoon to make the next round.
“I need you to go and ask ChatGPT how many Ghanaian coaches have a Pro License. Secondly, if you are dying to be a coach, I can help you and I can guide you. What I need to improve? I want to improve every single day,” he said.
“My players make me better, the people around me make me better, I’m open minded and I have a growth mindset. I want to believe that I’m at a certain level…
“Of course we are humans, nobody is perfect. We all want to improve and I working it. For me, I’m the best coach in the world.”
The 2027 U-23 AFCON will also serve as qualifiers for the 2028 Olympic Games with Ghana hoping to return to the tournament for the first time since 2004.
